newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: TAG Heuer shares under pressure.
newsitem.headline: TAG Heuer shares under pressure.

text.p: Shares of Swiss luxury watchmaker TAG Heuer SA dropped 5.8 percent in moderate trading before recovering a bit as speculative investors unloaded the stock that was first listed on September 27, dealers said.
Bearer shares -- priced at 245 Swiss francs during the IPO and first traded at 260 -- fell 13.25 to 214 in moderate trading on the Swiss Exchange before recovering to 222 at 1340 GMT.
"Speculative investors who bought the stock sight unseen are disappointed and are getting out," one dealer said, adding the market was marking down what many saw as an inflated issue price.
